description: Agent Migration: submit a migration plan for moving an agent or its work from one service, platform, model or provider to another, as recorded: optionally the source and the target with the kind of move, the plan’s scope as written, each asset the plan names with its class (data, memory, tools, identity, credentials, funds, history, settings, integrations, reputation or other), whether it is moving, staying behind, retiring with the source or undecided, whether the source can export it and how it leaves, and optionally the source’s own inventory of what it holds for the agent. The signed report lists every asset with its status, reads each of data, memory, tools, identity, credentials, funds and history as moving, staying, split or unaddressed, and names a scope that is unbounded: scope stated as everything or the whole account instead of a list, assets the source holds that appear on neither the moving nor the staying list, and assets listed as moving that the source cannot export; then undecided assets and core classes nobody addressed, with the fix for each. This reads an actual planned or completed move: whether an identity or a reputation record could be carried to another service in principle is wever_identity-portability-check or wever_reputation-portability-check, and a single handover of work between parties is wever_handover-check. Verdict migration_scope_unbounded, migration_scope_gaps, migration_scope_unverified or migration_scope_bounded. POST /api/migration-scope-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.

assets.description: Each asset the plan names, moving or staying.

class.description: Data, memory, tools, identity, credentials, funds, history, settings, integrations, reputation or other.

disposition.description: Moving, staying behind, retiring with the source or undecided.

name.description: An asset the plan names, such as the customer records or the signing key.

route.description: How it leaves the source, such as the account export or a key rotation.

inventory.description: What the source holds for the agent, to read the plan’s list against.

name.description: An asset the source holds for the agent, as the source’s own record lists it.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

kind.description: A platform, a model, a provider, a service, a host, a framework or other.

source.description: The service, platform, model or provider the agent or its work moves from.

target.description: The service, platform, model or provider it moves to.

scope_statement.description: The plan’s scope as written, read for wording such as everything or the whole account.

name: wever_migration-scope-check
title: Migration scope check
